decisions.reason: Top-level ESM tokens in client.js make the single 4.5MB classic combo fail compilation, so no entry registers; typert-registry is the first awaited innocent entry while the inner clause names the true bundle; no blanket ESM-invalid claim.

Bisects insert rows; explains node --check is insufficient and substitutes an ESM-token static check; full ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) contract with package-name identity, host require for React inside the factory, apply/inject exports.

Apply ordering is unconstrained and register asserts the slot exists now; shows ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register(...)) deferring until declaration; registrant supplies name/id/order (+label), never kind/scope.

Combo cached per boot so disk edits and refresh show stale bytes; full host stop/restart each iteration with the combo boot line as proof; taskkill /PID /T /F for the orphaned tree; EADDRINUSE attributed to the old process holding the port.

Per-artifact classic-script validation before concatenation with culprit attribution and blast-radius containment; authoring template plus checklist covering factory, host React, inject/apply, deferred cross-entry slots, restart/Windows cleanup.

caps.reason: Final advice mandates the ModuleLoader wrapper, inject-wrapped registration without kind/scope, and host restarts, never refresh-only verification.
